notes: Sanctum of All (CR 603.2d). Printed: 'If an ability of another Shrine you control triggers while you control six or more Shrines, that ability triggers an additional time.' Six Shrines: on seat 0's turn-3 first main phase Sanctum of Stone Fangs triggers, and its copy is counted and queued with it. The two are instances of one ability, so seat 0 is asked no order (one option), and no trigger of Sanctum of All's own goes on the stack. Each X = 6: seat 0 gains 12 (32), seat 1 loses 12 (8), as sanctum_of_all_23 pins. The only word is 'skip', for Sanctum of All's own upkeep may. On main 0b7f9c22 the copy came from a trigger of Sanctum of All's own, which went on the stack beside Stone Fangs' and asked seat 0 which resolved first: that ask has no word here and the step raises. Gate round W3, DESIGN_ATOM_ONTOLOGY §20.
